description: Use this when the user asks whether a website has an llms.txt file or whether it's set up correctly. It fetches /llms.txt and reports whether it was found, its size and title, and every place it doesn't follow the llmstxt.org format (missing H1, no summary line, links that aren't Markdown or https), with line numbers. It also lists the homepage's main pages, which can seed a new llms.txt. Input: one public website. Reads robots.txt, the homepage, /llms.txt and /.well-known/search as PreferlyBot; changes nothing.

website.description: The public website to check, like example.com or https://www.example.com. One site per call.

name: check_llms_txt
title: Check llms.txt
